payload.purpose_context: Five defects found using Spec Kitty in the charter repo (#6404-#6408): synthesized how-we-apply tactics never reach action context, org directive ids are shown as guessed stems, one org id in selected_directives wipes all governance, the first activation freezes the whole catalog, and the code reader calls a Gradle repo typescript. This Mission fixes them at their shared roots in the charter activation layer.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make charter governance deliver what the operator activated and selected: synthesized tactics, declared ids, org-pack selections, narrow activation and a correct stack signal.

payload.question: How should synthesized how-we-apply tactics reach action context (#6404)?

payload.final_answer: Emit directive --suggests--> tactic (built-in convention); reconcile owns edges by synthesized endpoint; existing projects re-run charter synthesize.

payload.question: What happens to a selected_directives/selected_paradigms id no layer knows (#6407)?

payload.final_answer: Validate against built-in + org packs + project; drop the unknown id with a diagnostic and resolve the rest.

payload.question: How should a first selection avoid materialising the whole catalog (#6408)?

payload.final_answer: Keep absent-key default; add opt-in --only on charter activate and an interview option initialising an absent key to selection + org-required ids, printing what stops being in force; fix contract text and warning.

payload.question: Should the stem-vs-declared-id fix cover every kind, not just directives (#6406 sibling)?

payload.final_answer: Yes: one stem->declared-id seam for every kind.

payload.question: Which delivery rule should synthesized how-we-apply tactics follow (#6404 follow-up)?

payload.final_answer: charter synthesize appends its tactic ids to an explicit activated_tactics list (absent key untouched); synthesized tactics are not seeded as roots and reach context only through their directive's suggests edge.

payload.wp_title: Governance resolution: declared ids, layer-aware selections, every-kind service getters
Root-first stack detection and neutrality slug matching
Identity index and default in-force snapshot
Interview --narrow-activation, charter command contract text and CLI reference docs
Governance diagnostics on compact, JSON, CLI, doctor and prompt surfaces
Synthesized tactic suggests edge and reconcile ownership
Synthesized tactic delivery through its directive and activation append
Opt-in narrow activation: charter activate --only and frozen-list warnings
Include, selection block, presets and charter list identity
Action bundle and DRG activation filter identity
